**This repository is a read-only mirror. Please open your pull request here instead:**
https://codeberg.org/dentroai/awesome-eu-infra

Why: a list about European digital sovereignty should live on European infrastructure. 
We chose Codeberg cause it's the biggest European Git host for public repos.
The GitHub mirror exists because that is where most developers are.

Changes merged here would be overwritten on the next sync, so pull requests opened
against the mirror are closed automatically. Sorry for the detour - and thanks for
contributing.
